items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember Helen Merrill. I remember we recorded up in Riverside

ctx.x: Because I’m thinking of Gato [Barbieri]. He had that thing. John Lewis and Helen Merrill? Any recollection about that one?

I remember Helen Merrill. I remember we recorded up in Riverside – what used to be Riverside recording studios. That’s where Orrin used to be also. I recorded up there with Mongo. Mongo did one of his last records up there at Riverside, along with Nat Adderley playing trumpet on a tune that I wrote called Bembe Blue.
John Lewis? Any recollection about John Lewis?
